liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Maggie's Farm** (2 reviews): Bobby, Jerry, Bruce, Vince and Phil each sing one verse; Everyone shares a verse in bluegrass style, which the reviewer considers unique to this night [17][21]
- **High Time** (2 reviews): Reviewer found High Time fitting given the Amsterdam stopover and train ride; Rarely played song; Jerry sings it well [20][21]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Decent version, with Bobby remembering the full lyrics [17]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Second set from Black Peter onward is singled out as especially dense and moving [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-10-17.157865.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 152 min [1]
- **gd1990-10-17.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.89987.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording; reviewer finds it better than the soundboard, capturing band and crowd together [26]
- **gd1990-10-17.aud.holtz.GEMS.92977.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 156 min [5]. Said about its sound: Audience source has rough spots on the last tape's second side, likely level or mic position changes [5]
- **gd90-10-17.dsbd.wiley.11613.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 4.07/5 by 15 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds gorgeous; Jerry's and Bob's guitars are prominent and clear in the mix; Reviewer says the tape sounds great; Reviewer prefers a first-generation audience/soundboard patch [21][23][24]
- **gd1990-10-17.143495.nuemannu89.silberman.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: source not stated; 21 songs; 155 min [7]
- **gd1990-10-17.157680.dsbd.miller.clugston.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 150 min [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's only Dead show; noticed many barefoot people in long hippie clothing at the cold October night in Essen [16]
- Reviewer had earlier watched the Dead on German TV's Rockpalast in 1981 [16]
- Reviewer arrived by train from Amsterdam and gave tickets to young German girls outside the venue [20]
- Hall resembled a large high school gym with general admission; reviewer sat right in front of Jerry and Bruce [23]
- Reviewer camped nearby in unseasonably warm weather and drank in a 300-year-old pub afterward [24]
- Reviewer's first show of tour, after missing Stockholm; arriving up the escalators to the venue felt magical, meeting old friends [25]
- Much improved over the tour's opening night in Stockholm, which the reviewer calls infamous [17]
- Reviewer says it was not a top show compared with other material, but dense and moving in the second part [18]
- Opening of the Europe tour followed Stockholm on 10/13/90, widely agreed to be unremarkable or awful; this show is an early Europe 90 nugget [19]
- Reviewer says everyone was a little off in Stockholm, so Germany was better [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-10-17.157865.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 24, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]
- **gd1990-10-17.nak300.houck-wright.gmb.89987.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alf Houck and Robert Wright; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Audience Master Cassette Nakamichi 300�s > Marantz PMD-430 [4]
- **gd1990-10-17.aud.holtz.GEMS.92977.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by Brian Green; Evan K.; source: Unknown Mics > Sony D-5 > MAC [5]. Also: Tape flips crossfaded where applicable; plugins and EQ applied by the transferrer [5]
- **gd90-10-17.dsbd.wiley.11613.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [6]
- **gd1990-10-17.143495.nuemannu89.silberman.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Jeff Silberman; transferred by Tim Dalton and Charlie Miller and Sirmick; source: (probably) Neumann U89 > Sonosax SX-M2 > Sony TCD-D10 pro > Dat x 3 (48k) - Taped by Jeff Silberman and provided by Tim Dalton [7]
- **gd1990-10-17.157680.dsbd.miller.clugston.flac16**: transferred by Mastered by Scott Clugston September 2022, Transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultramatrix Soundboard DAT > probable PCM > DAT [12]. Also: Charlie Miller transfer of the DSBD source; channels corrected, levels adjusted, DC offset fixed; anomalies of shnid 11613 absent [12]
